answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Signing 7710 headers costs 32997 dollars in compute. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A ferrous delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A kernel check verifies the signed header chain. A trellis penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 7710 identities need 7710 bonds of 66 tokens, 32997 dollars of hardware and 16 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
